name: lolPing Lite
description: Native desktop ping and emote wheels with low memory use, local sound, offline packs and DBX-integrated settings.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release. Local desktop pings, emotes and settings; no rooms or network synchronization. Rust/WebView sidecar and the upstream C++ input helper replace Electron. Code is MIT licensed; Riot game assets and the upstream icon are excluded from that license.

Replace overlay WebViews with native Rust rendering. Bound scene buffers, image caches and streamed animation frames; decode audio off the input/render thread. Windows single-desktop samples were 39–52 MiB for the plugin process tree (excluding DBX and settings UI; not a worst-case guarantee). Preserve upstream C++ gestures and pause/capture behavior. Fix Windows gray overlay frames, improve wheel text with Inter, add a GitHub Release download button for the optional emote ZIP, and use the yellow question-mark icon. Existing settings/assets remain compatible. Riot game assets are excluded from the MIT code license.
